items.description: The calendar and the summary still did not match on iPad. They were never going to: five columns by six rows at 40px cells tops out around 270px while the summary needs roughly 400px, so no amount of alignment fixes the column height. Cells now scale with the breakpoint (56px from 1024, 60px from 1280) and the two measure exactly equal.
Locking body overflow alone did not stop iOS Safari from scrolling the document. The root element is locked too now, and overscroll behaviour is disabled while Settings is open.
